scope.purpose: Consolidate format/type identities observed directly in the canonical executable and propagate them into canonical DMC Rengine format authorities and clean product recognition.
scope.non_goal: This census does not claim that every listed format has a completely recovered on-disk schema or writer.

additional_direct_content_checks.meaning: canonical DMC3 texture payload identity is TM2\0 on this path
additional_direct_content_checks.correction: Do not use a TIM2-only content probe as canonical EXE authority.

object_tags.boundary: This proves executable-side LIG2 FourCC/type ownership, not complete field semantics or direct file-header equivalence.

media_capability.boundary: Capability recognition is not ownership of these common media formats by DMC resource tooling.

runtime_path_or_filename_evidence.AFS: GData.afs/ at VA 0x140363188; GDataX360.afs/ also present

explicit_exclusions.name: HITS$
explicit_exclusions.reason: Historical five-byte claim; must not be reintroduced.

explicit_exclusions.name: HITS
explicit_exclusions.reason: Real four-byte collision payload identity in corpus/parser evidence; bounded canonical EXE ASCII/type sweep reports zero HITS occurrences. Absence from this bounded type system is not proof that no other consumer exists elsewhere.

explicit_exclusions.name: shader compiler metadata
explicit_exclusions.reason: Embedded compiler/container metadata, not DMC resource families.

explicit_exclusions.name: PE section names and printable machine-code fragments
explicit_exclusions.reason: Not accepted as format evidence without a classifier, handler, content check, constructor tag or runtime path ownership.

consumer_policy.identity_vs_schema: Keep EXE identity evidence independent from structural/semantic decoder support.
consumer_policy.mesh_policy: Only validated canonical MOD<space>/SCM<space> layouts may enter mesh decode. Three-byte runtime recognition must not imply mesh compatibility.
consumer_policy.media_policy: Capability-only generic media extensions must not be promoted to native DMC resource ownership without independent evidence.
consumer_policy.product_policy: EXE-confirmed identities may be recognized read-only while unresolved parsers remain fail-closed.
